Galactic Racer Tour Simulator

Build planner

Tour

Straight from the game files: the three backers and their 18 contracts with credits per unit, form scoring (points per finishing position and per won bet), the bottom 3 being labelled Underdog and the Underdog bonus, the six planets and their order, each planet's shop and reward odds by rarity, every price (parts, abilities, upgrades, packs, rerolls), credits per race and placing, the three risk bets, shop size (4 parts) and the 33.3% chance a part comes from a family you already own.

Assumed, because the game keeps it in code: how many options each reward or pack shows, how much an upgrade adds, that reroll prices reset at each shop, that a contract pays its rate for every unit you achieve (targets are shown as the game's starting goal), and the other 11 racers: each gets a hidden strength at the start of the tour and finishes by that strength plus a little variation each race, so a strong racer stays near the front. If the game labels you differently, use the Underdog switch on the bet screen. Change the first two under "Assumptions" when you start a run.

Recommendations: every part, ability and trait is tagged from its game rules: what it triggers on (a takedown, Redlining, Surging…) and what it gives (a condition, fuel, energy, a stat). An offer scores higher when it shares your build's focus, gives something your build triggers on, or triggers on something your build produces. Upgrades follow your racer style's own upgrade priority from the game files. It's a guide, not a solver.

Fan-made tool. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Lucasfilm, Electronic Arts or the game's developers.
